assertions: Every subprocess return code checked against expectation and no traceback; negative guards assert refusal reason and absent output.
Frozen findings exactly Y1.2/Y1.3 each .05 mm; all DRC runs assert exact violation counts/types, effective .25/.55/0 parameters and native-consistent shortfalls.
Actual emitted board native copper polygon bounds establish .50/.52/.55/.60 and arbitrary33degree geometry; boundary tolerance 1e-6 mm.
Every core written output retains 17 fixed serialized footprint blocks, all non-footprint board text and existing brief/project/custom-rule bytes; original baseline SHA unchanged.
Counterexample actor no-op writes preserve source except equivalent at-number/angle formatting and retain present siblings; strict refusals produce no output.
Native chamfer/padstack persisted and reloaded with below-floor copper; both parser paths disclose their approximations and cannot certify coverage.
Direct multi, in-place atomic rejection, near/snap, dry-run, inherited dirty improvement, strict refusal, project/fallback and alternate engine output paths exercised.
limits: Custom .kicad_dru edge constraints are disclosed as unmeasured; their conditional/local geometry is not evaluated. Scalar floor remains separate.
Exact nonrectangular/custom/chamfer/padstack geometry not certified by placement; conservative or sampled findings remain partial.
Independent DRC retains different fallback/project minimum/fabrication/severity policy. Matching .25/.55/0 exercised where policies agree, not unified.
No full native KiCad DRC, full repository suite, routed connectivity, body/height certification or instruction/model trials performed by this verifier.
Alternate optimize/seed/reconstruct use inherited/no-op geometry; proves forwarding/report/output preservation in those paths, not optimization quality or every search candidate.
Native-controlled variants mutate copies solely as geometry test inputs; their construction does not claim mechanical validity. Original public fixtures remain unchanged.
